sections.title: Building On What Worked
sections.body:
You asked us to come back to the topics that landed. Two from the summer are back in October.
What worked Where it returns in October
Society's Risk Capital (Aug 18) Oct 13 · The Capital Has a Mandate. The Field Isn't Ready. Takes the same argument a
Your best-performing post of the summer step further: the capital is ready to take risks, but the field isn't set up to receive it.
Oct 8 sets it up.
The 40-Hour application (Aug 13) Oct 22 · The Invisible Labor of Grants Teams. Same cost, seen from the funder side:
Your strongest post in the grant-burden series the work that leaves no record.

cta: Book your next interview with Danny: 30 minutes on what you're hearing from funders this fall. That becomes November's posts.
